Description: Encapsulates one bus transaction to Instruction Counter registers plus the instr_retire pulse. Same register layout as Cycle Counter (CTRL/STATUS/CNT_LO/CNT_HI) but adds instr_retire field.
Key_Methods: new(); convert2string(); do_copy(); do_compare(); do_print(); randomize()
Signals_Used: addr[7:0], data[31:0], we, wstrb[3:0], rdata[31:0], ready, err, instr_retire

Description: Drives bus transactions to Instruction Counter AND drives the instr_retire signal as a 1-cycle pulse per transaction where retire_en=1. Coordinates pulse timing with bus request phase.
Signals_Used: clk, rst_n, bus_req, bus_we, bus_addr, bus_wdata, bus_wstrb, bus_ready, bus_rdata, bus_err, instr_retire

Description: Monitors bus transactions AND samples instr_retire pulses on each posedge clk. Records both bus activity and retire events into seq_items and writes to analysis port.
Signals_Used: clk, bus_req, bus_ready, bus_we, bus_addr, bus_rdata, instr_retire

Description: Standard UVM sequencer parameterised on instr_cnt_seq_item.
Container for instruction counter VIP. Conditionally instantiates driver/sequencer. Monitor always present.
Reference model that only increments expected count when BOTH EN=1 AND instr_retire=1 simultaneously. Verifies CNT_LO/CNT_HI reads match expected count. Checks shadow latch atomicity.
Covergroups for: addr (CTRL/STATUS/CNT_LO/CNT_HI), retire×EN cross, shadow trigger events.
Shared tasks: do_write(addr,data), do_read(addr), drive_retire(count, with_en).
Writes CTRL=0x01 to enable, then pulses instr_retire N times, reads CNT_LO, verifies == N.
Enables counter but holds instr_retire=0 for 50 cycles, reads CNT_LO and verifies == 0. Then drives retire pulses and verifies count increments.
Enables counter, drives retire pulses, then atomically reads CNT_LO (triggers shadow latch) followed by CNT_HI. Verifies shadow captured correctly.
Enables both Cycle Counter and Instruction Counter simultaneously. Drives only N retire pulses in M cycles (N<M). Verifies Instr CNT_LO == N and Cycle CNT_LO ≈ M independently.
Signals_Used: CTRL(0x00), CNT_LO(0x08), instr_retire, cycle_cnt bus signals

Description: Simulates mixed retire traffic: bursts of 5 retires followed by 3-cycle gaps, repeated 10 times. Verifies total count == 50.
